snippet.title: 💸 Casino Management Simulator 🎰 | EARLY ACCESS OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
🎮 PLAY NOW ON STEAM: 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2823790/Casino_Management_Simulator/

🎰 Play Casino Management Simulator on Steam!

Manage and grow your own casino. Hire staff, place slot machines and table games, control finances, and design your layout. Watch NPCs buy chips, play, and cash out as you expand your casino into a profitable business.

You’re the boss. Balance the thrill, chaos, and profit.

🧠 GAME FEATURES

•Build and customize your casino floor with slots, tables, and cashiers

•Manage NPC guests

•Hire and assign staff to different stations

•Handle chip purchases, cashouts, and daily financial reports

•Expand your empire and unlock new areas

•Spend your skill points

And MORE!

📅 Release: Early Access planned for Q4 2025
🎮 Developer: BroxStudios
💬 Follow the journey: https://discord.gg/vk9zaquhxh

https://broxstudios.com/
